title: blueprint-crafting spec run-record
description: The normalized record the verdict-emitter (I6) produces for an artifact-convergence run. Two verdict fields, kept structurally isolated: process_converged (the process axis — high confidence, convergeable) and rightness (the outcome axis — a CONSTANT 'human_confirm_required', out of this skill's scope). Field isolation is ENFORCED by the schema: rightness is an enum with exactly ONE value, so it can never change regardless of process_converged. Mirrors parallel-development's run-record shape, moved upstream (arch-design section 5). Validated in infra/test/run_record_schema.py.

artifact_type.description: Which artifact type this run converged (or failed to).

process_converged.description: Process-axis verdict (high confidence). true iff the inner ring passed (no Blocker) AND the outer ring had no Blocker. This is the convergeable field.

rightness.description: CONSTANT — the outcome axis (is the artifact 'right') is out of this skill's scope. The enum has exactly ONE value to STRUCTURALLY enforce field isolation: no matter process_converged, rightness is always human_confirm_required. A consumer must never read a green process_converged as outcome-axis success (rule 3; ADR: process/outcome axis separation).

coverage.description: Which checks ran / were skipped / degraded (honest degradation, rule 3).

caveats.description: Gloss for consumers — e.g. 'rightness is human_confirm_required by design; do not misread process_converged as outcome success'.

passed.description: true iff this ring had zero Blockers.

blockers.description: Count of Blocker-severity failures in this ring.

findings.description: Total findings (all severities) in this ring.
